tablet.notes:
Lock a chat: hold a chat, tap More, then Lock chat (or use its Info page). It asks for your face, fingerprint or PIN each time, and its words stay hidden in the list, the widget and notifications.
Tap a person's picture (at the top of a chat, or beside their messages in a group) for their card: Message, Call, Add to contacts and Info. Info opens a page for the person or the group, with the group's people and its name.
New Messages widget for the home screen: your latest chats, a New message button, and a tap opens the chat.
The round Message+ icon no longer shows signal bars when the flip phone has only Wi-Fi: it says No cell service.

tablet-regular.notes:
Hold a message: the whole screen goes soft, emoji reactions sit above it and a card of actions below (Forward, Copy, Delete, Select more, Info), like Google Messages. Select more and the Details page match too.
The keyboard closes after you send and when you swipe through the messages. The voice recorder is much smaller. The tablet icon on messages another tablet sent no longer goes missing.
Fixed a crash when opening a video that had been downloaded ahead.
Since the last update: bubbles stop at about three quarters of the width.

messageplus.notes:
Right after a restart, the Message key (right soft key) now opens Message+ instead of Verizon's app.
Pressing it again right after leaving Message+ now works on the first press.

messageplus_previous.notes: The Message key (right soft key) now opens Message+ right away, even just after pressing End or Home. Before, it could take up to 5 seconds.

tablet2.notes:
Fixes messages showing twice after the phone's history sync, and makes opening the app with a large message history much faster (the cleanup of those copies no longer scans every message again and again).
Also in this copy: the Performance log (Settings > Performance log), and group texts from a new group start their own group.
